expectations.text: The selected prebuilt is `app-store-page` and common visual-asset documents remain store-neutral.
expectations.evidence: The response reports validation with `--prebuilt app-store-page --store google-play`; common asset-system.md explicitly assigns store-specific specifications to stores/google-play.md and says common files do not duplicate store sizes, counts, formats, or policies.

expectations.text: Only the in-scope Google Play adaptation is added as `stores/google-play.md`; the explicitly excluded Apple App Store is neither researched nor given a file.
expectations.evidence: The receipt lists docs/design-system-visual-assets/stores/google-play.md as the only store adaptation, while index.md and google-play.md explicitly exclude Apple App Store; no Apple store file appears in the workspace file list.

expectations.text: Mutable Google Play sizes, counts, formats, and policies are verified from current official Google sources rather than memory.
expectations.evidence: stores/google-play.md records current app icon, feature graphic, screenshot, preview-video, and device-specific sizes/counts/formats/policy rules and identifies Google Play official Help sources; the deterministic grading also confirms an observable HTTPS source URL and real ISO verification date.

expectations.text: The store file records official source URLs and a verification date near mutable requirements.
expectations.evidence: stores/google-play.md has an 조사 상태와 공식 출처 section immediately before the mutable requirements, with three support.google.com HTTPS URLs and the verification date 2026-08-29.

expectations.text: Google Play-specific differences are not generalized into the common visual-asset contract.
expectations.evidence: asset-system.md states that asset roles are common while store-specific size/count/format/upload requirements are owned only by stores/google-play.md; visual-language.md and delivery-and-versioning.md link to that store document for conditional rules instead of embedding them.
